recipe.name: Smoky White Bean and Turkey Bacon Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C.
Heat olive oil in an oven-safe skillet, sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add chopped turkey bacon and cook until lightly browned.
Stir in tomato passata, smoked paprika and cannellini beans; simmer 5 minutes.
Make two small wells in the mixture and crack in the eggs.
Sprinkle cheddar over the top and bake 8-10 minutes until eggs are set.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot.

recipe.name: Grilled Chicken and Hummus Wrap
instructions: Season chicken with cumin, paprika, salt and pepper; grill or pan-sear until cooked through, then slice.
Warm the tortilla briefly on a dry skillet to soften.
Spread hummus and greek yogurt over the tortilla.
Layer lettuce, tomato, cucumber, red onion, feta and sliced chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil and lemon juice.
Roll tightly into a wrap, slice in half and serve.

recipe.name: Korean Beef Bulgogi Rice Tray Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 220°C.
Whisk soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, honey and gochujang into a marinade.
Toss sliced beef in half the marinade and let sit 10 minutes.
Spread rice across a lined baking tray, top with sliced zucchini and carrot.
Arrange marinated beef over the vegetables and drizzle remaining marinade evenly.
Bake for 15-18 minutes until beef is cooked and vegetables are tender.
Fry the egg separately to a runny yolk and place on top before serving.
Garnish with spring onion and sesame seeds.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Spinach, Feta and Turkey Scramble
instructions: Heat olive oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
Add ground turkey and cook, breaking it up, until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes.
Add cherry tomatoes and spinach, sauté until spinach wilts and tomatoes soften slightly.
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper, pour into the skillet.
Stir gently and cook over low-medium heat until eggs are just set, then crumble feta over the top.
Toast the sourdough bread and serve alongside the scramble.

recipe.name: Grilled Lamb Kofta with Charred Vegetables and Tahini
instructions: In a bowl, combine ground lamb, grated onion, parsley, cumin, cinnamon, garlic and salt; mix well and shape into 4 oblong kofta.
Toss zucchini, red bell pepper and cauliflower with olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to high heat.
Grill the kofta for 3-4 minutes per side until charred and cooked through.
Grill the vegetables alongside, turning occasionally, until tender and charred in spots, about 8-10 minutes.
Whisk tahini with lemon juice and water until smooth to make the sauce.
Plate the kofta with the grilled vegetables, drizzle with tahini sauce and sprinkle with sumac.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Vanilla Almond Butter Protein Shake
instructions: Add almond milk, protein powder, almond butter, and heavy cream to a blender.
Add ice cubes, vanilla extract, and cinnamon.
Blend on high for 30-45 seconds until smooth and frothy.
Pour into a glass and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Italian Shrimp and Zucchini Stir Fry with Garlic and Chili
instructions: Pat shrimp dry and season lightly with sea salt.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat until shimmering.
Add garlic and chili flakes, stir-fry for 20 seconds until fragrant but not browned.
Add shrimp in a single layer, cook 1-2 minutes per side until just pink and opaque.
Add zucchini slices, stir-fry over high heat for 2-3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add cherry tomatoes and toss for 1 minute until slightly softened.
Remove from heat, squeeze in lemon juice, and toss.
Plate and top with grated parmigiano reggiano and fresh parsley.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Greek Yoghurt Bowl with Walnuts, Pumpkin Seeds and Mixed Berries
instructions: Spoon the yoghurt into a serving bowl.
Top with blueberries, walnuts and pumpkin seeds.
Sprinkle over the rolled oats.
Drizzle honey over the top just before serving.

recipe.name: Mediterranean Roast Pork Loin with Lemon Potatoes, Roasted Peppers and Fennel
instructions: Preheat oven to 210°C (fan).
Toss potato wedges, fennel, red pepper and red onion with half the olive oil, half the garlic, oregano, salt and pepper on a roasting tray.
Roast vegetables for 15 minutes while preparing the pork.
Rub pork loin with remaining olive oil, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Push vegetables to one side of the tray, place pork loin in the center and roast together for 30-35 minutes until pork reaches 63°C internal temperature and vegetables are golden and tender.
Rest the pork for 5 minutes, then slice.
Scatter kalamata olives over the vegetables and serve alongside the sliced pork with pan juices.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Peppered Mackerel with Lemon and Watercress
instructions: Flake the smoked mackerel fillet onto a plate, removing any bones.
Toss watercress with a squeeze of lemon juice and a drizzle of olive oil.
Arrange mackerel alongside the dressed watercress.
Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice and freshly cracked black pepper.
Serve immediately at room temperature or lightly chilled.

recipe.name: Vietnamese Braised Beef Shank with Star Anise and Ginger (Bò Kho-style)
instructions: Cut beef shank into large chunks and pat dry.
Heat sesame oil in a heavy pot over medium-high heat; sear beef chunks until browned on all sides.
Add shallot, garlic and ginger; sauté until fragrant, about 2 minutes.
Add star anise and cinnamon stick, toasting briefly to release aroma.
Pour in beef bone broth and fish sauce, scraping up any browned bits.
Bring to a simmer, cover, and braise on low heat for 2.5 to 3 hours until beef is fork-tender.
Remove from heat and let the pot rest, covered, for 20 minutes to allow flavors to deepen.
Discard star anise and cinnamon stick, skim excess fat if needed.
Stir in lime juice and garnish with fresh cilantro before serving hot.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Smoky Baked White Beans with Turkey Bacon and Poached Eggs
instructions: Heat olive oil in a skillet and sauté onion and garlic until soft.
Add smoked paprika, tomato passata, and molasses; simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in cooked white beans and simmer gently for 10 minutes until thickened, adding a splash of water if needed.
In a separate pan, crisp the turkey bacon until browned, then chop and stir half into the beans, reserving the rest for topping.
Poach the eggs in simmering water for 3 minutes until whites are set but yolks remain soft.
Toast the sourdough bread.
Spoon the baked beans into a bowl, top with poached eggs and reserved turkey bacon, and garnish with parsley.
Serve immediately with the toast on the side.

recipe.name: Smoky BBQ-Spiced Beef Brisket Curry with Coconut-Lime Rice
instructions: Season brisket chunks generously with smoked paprika, chipotle powder, and cumin.
Sear brisket in a hot pot until browned on all sides, then set aside.
In the same pot, sauté onion, garlic, and ginger until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste and BBQ sauce, cooking for 2 minutes.
Return brisket to the pot, add beef stock and coconut milk, and bring to a simmer.
Cover and simmer on low heat for 90 minutes until brisket is tender, adding bell pepper in the last 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, cook basmati rice in water until fluffy, then stir through lime juice.
Skim excess fat from the curry sauce if needed, then finish with chopped cilantro.
Serve the brisket curry over the lime rice.
recipe.prep_notes: Yields 4 portions, eaten across 1 day(s). Portion immediately, refrigerate in airtight containers; reheat thoroughly before serving.

recipe.name: Herbed Egg White & Yolk Scramble with Smoked Salmon
instructions: Whisk whole egg, egg white, and heavy cream together with a pinch of salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat.
Pour in egg mixture and cook slowly, folding gently with a spatula until just set and creamy.
Fold in torn smoked salmon pieces during the last minute of cooking to warm through.
Remove from heat, sprinkle with chopped chives and dill, and serve immediately.

recipe.name: Cajun Chicken and Andouille One-Pan Skillet
instructions: Pat chicken thighs dry and cut into large chunks; season with smoked paprika, cayenne, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Heat olive oil and butter in a large cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear seasoned chicken pieces until browned on all sides, about 6-7 minutes; remove and set aside.
Add sliced andouille sausage to the same pan and brown for 2-3 minutes to render fat.
Add onion, bell pepper, celery, and garlic to the pan (the Cajun 'holy trinity') and sauté until softened, about 5 minutes.
Return chicken to the skillet, toss everything together, and cook for another 5 minutes until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Adjust seasoning with extra salt, pepper, or cayenne to taste and serve straight from the pan.
